items.requirement: Produce a unique submission TIF; never copy a prior GEMSDOE submission
items.detail: 19 distinct prior artifacts compared from data/probes/; max Jaccard vs ours 0.0144 (gems22-h23-a-dti-optimal-emission-6pct-20261002-e2ec4b49-nan), vs the 0.2600 incumbent 0.0076. Coverage limit: the family lists 40+ sites but only 19 distinct scored artifacts are obtainable, so 'unlike anything in the 40+ sites' is proven for the obtainable set only.

items.requirement: Upload must not trigger 'Predicted values must be in range [0, 1]'
items.detail: read back from the shipped bytes: float32 single band, values exactly [0.0, 1.0], range [0.0, 1.0], 0 NaN inside the footprint, 0 below 0 and 0 above 1. NaN appears outside the footprint only in the labelled twin, which is not the file to upload.

items.requirement: The TIF must be one-click downloadable, said in an executive summary at the very top
items.detail: the first content block is the executive-summary hero whose <h2> is '⬇ One-click submission file'; the download link occurs at byte 1096 of 12785, before the first ordinary section at byte 4329; a .zip of the same bytes and the NaN-outside twin sit next to it; the auto-regenerated status table follows the download.

items.requirement: Unique filename and a short note to distinguish the submission
items.detail: name 'GEMS44_n-strand-ssmc_20261006T113858Z_bf3b3914' (timestamp + content hash); note as pasted into the portal: 'GEMS44 n-strand-ssmc | supervised transfer of USGS SGMC strands absent from the given catalogue (U) onto the 19 official bands; exact greedy max-coverage emission 44090 dots; <=200 m catalogue ring excluded; none on the known mask; unique f'

items.requirement: Explain why 0.2778 (GEMSDOE32/h33) was the prior best and whether >0.2778 is reachable
items.detail: reachability is answered mechanically (marginal-credit break-even: a dot pays iff k > 0.2·DTI, so at 0.3345 only dots within 280 m of a scored truth pay; the required hit fraction is computed for rho = 0 and rho = 1). The attribution of the 0.2778 file to that rule is NOT confirmed: thread 11525 is a second-hand statement that matches only the file name, so it stays an open irregularity rather than a claim.

items.requirement: Register 3-5 ranked candidate hypotheses with layers, signature, why-unmapped, and difference
items.detail: 9 hypotheses registered; every one carries all of ['layers', 'physical_signature', 'expected_dti', 'cost', 'differs_from_prior_work']; 4 carry an explicit falsification test and 0 record the falsifying result.

items.requirement: Validate the top candidate on a spatially-blocked holdout before spending a submission slot
items.detail: fold construction: learned fields re-fitted per fold on the three training quadrants only; four quadrant blocks, mass_fold = M_global * allowed_q / allowed_total; gate 'frame N: mean fold delta vs incumbent >= +0.005 and >= 3 of 4 folds positive'. Held out: candidate 0.396379 vs the real incumbent artifact 0.13564, delta 0.26074, 4/4 folds positive. The shipped field/mass was chosen by leave-one-fold-out, not by the in-sample mean.

items.requirement: The standing prompt lives in README.md and is re-read every session
items.detail: section 0 'STANDING PROMPT - read this at the start of every session' is present; the submission record, the repository map and the verification commands are in the same file.

items.requirement: The site removes manual checking by showing an up-to-date feed
items.detail: the first panel is compiled at build time from registry/*.json: artifact slug, sha256 prefix, byte count, format-verification result, exact-vs-fast operator agreement, holdout gate, dated leaderboard snapshot and the open-irregularity count. It states that DrivenData's terms of use prohibit automated polling, so the leaderboard row is a dated snapshot rather than a live poll.

items.requirement: Clean GitHub Pages site with auditable tables and official source links
items.detail: 29 tables across 7 pages; every page footer names the registry file it was compiled from; official links include the problem description, the leaderboard, thread 11516 and the reference solution.

items.requirement: At least three verification passes before shipping
items.detail: pass A contract read-back, pass B metric re-derived independently plus toy cases, pass C uniqueness (17 checks, 0 failures); pass 3 is this checklist; the metric unit tests run separately.

items.requirement: Flag irregularities for review; record remaining work and limitations
items.detail: 17 irregularities recorded, each with what/why/status/action_taken; the limitations page carries the data-provenance caveat (the official files are hash-pinned mirrors supplied with the prior family repositories, not re-downloaded from the organizer) and the probe-coverage caveat.

items.requirement: Open a pull request and merge to main
items.detail: PR #3 #3 (b9d4ad8, merged) landed this session's verification harness, registries, site and first artifact; PR #5 #5 (186bda8, merged) landed the frame falsification, the field re-pick and the current artifact. Both are recorded in README section 2.2b; main carries the artifact in both submissions/ and docs/downloads/ with the withdrawn one removed.
